title: Console perf: opening a record refetches the list 10×, repeats field-access ×4 and security/explain ×2, and the inbox bell polls every 10 s — dedupe in-flight requests, pin the list's query key, push instead of poll
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filed from the record-page epic #26676 as a sub-issue after the maintainer's 「别人的界面很丝滑，但是我们的界面总觉得卡顿，云端更卡」 and the seat's measurement (2026-10-29, console `main` `273137d227` in Vite dev mode against HotCRM on `localhost:4001`, Chrome, 1918 px). Ruling: 「立 A（ui 缺陷：列表不重取、同 URL 去重、消息中心停轮询）…两张卡，p1」. This card is the client-side waste; the server-side shape is #27627.

## Measured (Resource Timing + PerformanceObserver longtask, buffer raised to 20 000)

Opening one HotCRM contact from the contacts list (`?recordId=`):

| | cold (first open after load) | warm (second open) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| requests until idle | **45** | **23** |
| drawer visible | 310 ms | 300 ms |
| last request end | 440 ms (+ a `PATCH sys_user_preference` at 850 ms) | 360 ms |
| long tasks | 2 / 144 ms | 3–4 / 280–400 ms |

Pure waste inside those:
- **The contacts list query (`GET /api/v1/data/crm_contact?…top=50…`) is refetched 10 times** between 309 and 517 ms of the cold open — one per arriving child-object metadata (`/meta/object/crm_event`, `crm_event_attendee`, `crm_lead`, `crm_opportunity`, `crm_task`, `crm_case`, `crm_contract`, `crm_campaign_member`, `crm_quote` — 9) plus one. Each metadata arrival re-renders the list host and its data hook refetches. Twenty hit the same defect (twentyhq/twenty#27438 cut row renders per open from 244 to 4).
- **`GET /api/v1/data/crm_contact/:id/field-access` ×4**, identical URL, in the same 50 ms, all 404 (consumers: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/recordFieldAccess.tsx`, `plugin-form/src/recordFieldAccess.tsx`, `permissions/src/RecordFieldAccessScope.tsx`, `data-objectstack/src/index.ts`).
- **`POST /api/v1/security/explain` ×2** at the same instant (`plugin-detail/src/useRecordEditable.ts`, `plugin-detail/src/queueClaim.ts`).
- **The inbox bell polls `sys_inbox_message` every 10 s and `approvals/requests` every 30 s** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts`: `INBOX_POLL_MS = 10_000`, `APPROVALS_POLL_MS = 30_000`, `HIDDEN_POLL_MS = 60_000`) while the page already holds two WebSocket connections; the measuring tab had made more than 110 000 requests over one working day. On the cloud deployment the same poll took 2.4–7.5 s per call under load, competing with the user's own navigation.

Why it matters more on the cloud: with ~0.5 s per request on `huayan.objectos.app` (see #27627 for the server side), every redundant request is half a second the user waits.

## Target

1. **The list's query key is independent of `?recordId=` and of child metadata arrivals.** Opening, stepping and closing a record must not refetch the list (a render-count / request-count test: 0 list requests on open). The list host re-renders at most once per record change.
2. **In-flight request dedupe at the data layer**: identical `GET`s (same URL) and identical `POST security/explain` bodies share one in-flight promise and one short-lived cache entry (per page life for metadata, per record for `field-access` / `explain`); a 404 `field-access` is cached as "no scope" for the record's life, not retried four times.
3. **Child metadata loads once**: the first open of a record pulls each related object's metadata once per session (today: once per open on the cold path), cached in the same data layer.
4. **No polling while a push channel is open**: the inbox bell and the approvals badge subscribe to the existing WebSocket feed; polling remains only as the fallback when the socket is down, at ≥ 60 s, and pauses in hidden tabs (today's `HIDDEN_POLL_MS` logic stays for the fallback).
5. No metadata key; ⛔ `packages/spec/**`.

## File surface

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx` + the list data hook it uses, `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` (dedupe / cache), `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/recordFieldAccess.tsx`, `plugin-form/src/recordFieldAccess.tsx`, `permissions/src/RecordFieldAccessScope.tsx`, `plugin-detail/src/useRecordEditable.ts`, `plugin-detail/src/queueClaim.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts` + `useInboxBell.ts` (push subscription), tests beside, changeset.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: opening a record from a list fires 0 list requests; the same URL in flight is fetched once; `security/explain` for the same record and user is posted once; child metadata is fetched once per session; with a socket open the bell makes no polling requests in 60 s, with the socket closed it polls at ≥ 60 s.
2. A before / after request log on the same HotCRM contact (cold and warm), in the PR body, from the measurement recipe below.
3. The epic seat re-measures in the console preview before ACCEPT (maintainer: 「车队开发完后你审核效果」).

<details><summary>Measurement recipe (browser console, on the list page)</summary>

```js
performance.setResourceTimingBufferSize(20000); performance.clearResourceTimings();
const t0 = performance.now(); document.querySelector('a[data-testid="primary-field-link"]').click();
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 7000));
const g = {}; for (const r of performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(r => r.initiatorType !== 'script')) {
  const k = r.name.replace(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+/, '').replace(/\?.*$/, '') + (r.name.includes('top=50') ? ' [LIST]' : '');
  (g[k] = g[k] || { n: 0, first: 1e9 }).n++; g[k].first = Math.min(g[k].first, Math.round(r.startTime - t0)); }
console.table(Object.entries(g).map(([u, v]) => ({ u, ...v })));
```
</details>
